rows: Tornado in the Coldspring Terrace Subdivision along Lake Livingston. Four injuries in two homes that received major damage.
Penny-size hail at the intersection of FM Road 2693 and FM Road 2778 right at the Walker-San Jacinto County line.
Waterspout sighted over Lake Livingston just west of Onalaska.
A tree was downed by strong thunderstorm winds.
A tree was down on a car. A powerline was also reported down at the intersection of SH 156 and Padgett Road.
Thunderstorm winds downed trees and power lines.

Golf ball size hail was observed.

There were reports of golf ball hail were received in the town of Coldspring.

There were numerous trees down in and around the Double Lake Recreation area. There was roof damage to a historic pavilion due to a downed pine tree.

Numerous trees down just north of Squier Cemetary in southern San Jacinto County. Some trees were on houses and trailer homes.

A funnel cloud sighted by fire department and rescue people touched down twice in a pasture. Swirling dirt was evident near the intersection of FM 1725 and Tony Tap Road. There was little damage caused by this EF0 tornado.
Trees were downed along FM 1725 and FM 2025 west of Shepherd.

Trees were blown down near 150 and FM 2693 and a vehicle was struck by a fallen tree. The driver only sustained minor injuries.
Trees were blown down on Stringtown Road.
There were downed trees with one tree collapsing onto a power line that caused a fire.
